node.statement: Applying the ordinary chain rule at p and Pi_delta(p) to those two identities gives DG_{Pi_delta(p)} composed with DPi_delta_p = I and DPi_delta_p composed with DG_{Pi_delta(p)} = I. Thus DPi_delta_p is a linear isomorphism; since p was arbitrary, this holds everywhere.
